eq-ch08-theta-def: The positivity factor $\Theta_i$ limits a cell's total outflow to its content over the step.
eq-ch08-theta-bound: With the donor factor on every draining face, $V_i(u_i+\Delta t\,\Delta u_i) \ge \eta\,u_iV_i + \Delta t\,\mathrm{in}_i$, non-negative for a cell non-negative at stage entry.
eq-ch08-carry-dm: The mass withheld at a face by the limiter is $(1 - \Theta_d)F$.
eq-ch08-borrow-fractions: A cloud's deficit is shared among its parent vapours by the fractions $f_n=\nu_{nk}\mu_n/\sum_m\nu_{mk}\mu_m$, which sum to one, so the cell total is unchanged.
